**{{< var days.d1.question >}}**

Day 1 starts from counting words and ends at attention. Each module fixes a specific weakness of the one before it, and the same small datasets run through all four labs so you can measure the improvement.

::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple"}
**Optional, 08:00–09:00: [Module 0 · {{< var modules.m00.title >}}](lectures/00-coding-agents.qmd).** A self-serve hour before the 09:00 welcome. You install a terminal coding agent, build two small data apps with it in Python or R, and publish them on GitHub Pages. You can also do it at home as pre-work. Nothing later in the workshop depends on it.
:::

{{< include /_includes/day-1.md >}}
